model.requested_via: --model claude-opus-5 (explicit on every worker invocation; never omitted, never 'default')
model.precedent: EXP-0011 run-arm.mjs MODEL default and EXP-0012 pin — same model family as the measured cost baseline
model.id_check: provider-native id extracted from the FIRST call's stream (system init model + result modelUsage keys); membership in the allowed set is checked BEFORE any second call; mismatch = MODEL_ID_NOT_ALLOWED, study aborts with zero further spend

cli.preflight: claude --version must equal expected_version exactly; drift = REFUSED (config re-freeze and fresh authorization required)
cli.drift_disclosure: the CLI AUTO-UPDATED 2.1.229 -> 2.1.231 between the v3 freeze and the v4 leg, caught live by the version preflight (AMENDMENT v4). This environment's CLI updates outside harness control: the pin is enforced per launch, the binary is a symlink (/opt/node22/bin/claude -> /opt/claude-code/bin/claude, recorded by exec-registry executableIdentity), and any further drift before spend refuses the launch until re-frozen and re-authorized

invocation.env: scrubbedEnv + CI=1 + BASH_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS=600000 + BASH_MAX_TIMEOUT_MS=600000 (EXP-0011 transport precedent)
invocation.max_turns: not limited by flag — bounded by the wall-clock ceiling below (recorded honestly; EXP-0011 precedent)
invocation.timeout_mechanism: controller-owned timer: SIGKILL to the worker process group at ceiling; terminal_reason=timeout recorded; cell is infrastructure-invalid under the reliability gate
invocation.retry_policy: NO automatic retries; reruns exist only as whole-pair reruns under the frozen reliability gate (max 1 per pair, max 2 total), plus at most one seed rerun per sequence
invocation.topology: SERIAL — one worker at a time across the whole study (owner default; the synthetic CPU calibration is not provider-isolation proof, and prior E4 contamination showed elapsed inflation under load). Elapsed remains a secondary metric under serial execution; token metrics primary.

streaming_schema.validation: telemetry.mjs parseStream — typed reasons for missing/malformed/duplicate result, stale session, model-id mismatch; missing telemetry is NOT_METERED, never inferred

calls.seed_semantics: ONE neutral renderer-independent seed call per sequence at p1 (no UCDL treatment, no renderer); its distilled store is frozen (digest-pinned) before p2 and is the SAME store for p2 and p3 in both arms — no arm-dependent accumulation can contaminate the pair

spend.grounding: EXP-0011 measured (same model, same task shape, n=40): mean $1.867/cell, p90 $3.388, max $4.282, median elapsed 587s, max 1149s
spend.budget_gate: before EVERY provider call: spent_so_far + per_call_worst_usd <= proposed_ceiling_usd, else HALT with reason BUDGET_CEILING before the call is made (never after)
